temporal_notes: Larval collection was conducted between January to September 2014 covering three main seasons: rainy/long rains (Jan-Mar), short rains (May-Jun), and dry season (Aug-Sep).
coord_source_text: Magu district (02°35′S-033°26′E) in Mwanza region, Tanzania.
source_text: A total of 2205 mosquito larvae of Anopheles gambiae s.l were collected from which 1500 adults females were obtained... The collection was conducted between January to September 2014 covering the three main seasons
